LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.Title: Work layout editor
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.NoGame: Load a colony to edit the work layout.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.WorkTypeTip: Native work type. Expand to see unassigned WorkGivers. Drag them into a custom group, or right-click a WorkGiver to assign it.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.CustomGroupTi: Drag the handle to reorder among work types. Drop WorkGivers here to assign them. Right-click to rename or delete.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.WorkGiverTip: Drag the handle to assign or reorder. Right-click to assign to a group or remove from the current group.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.NoCustomGroup: No custom groups yet. Add one first.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.LayoutEditor.ApplyGroupPre: Applies this group preset at the end of the current layout. Reorder it in the layout editor afterward.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.ConfirmDeleteGroup: Delete group "{0}"? Assigned WorkGivers will return to their native work types.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.ConfirmReplaceLayout: Replace all current custom work groups with this layout preset?
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.ExpandGroupTip: Ctrl+click to expand WorkGivers in this group
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.CollapseGroupTip: Ctrl+click to collapse WorkGivers in this group
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.Settings.LayoutEditorTip: Edit colony work layout from the Work tab using the L button, or from this mod's layout window.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.Settings.DefaultLayoutTip: When set, this layout is applied automatically when starting a new game (only if no groups exist yet).
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.Settings.ModRemovalTip: Group data is stored outside the colony save. Use Prepare save for mod removal, then save the colony before disabling this mod — loading without that step can break saves that still reference this mod. After updating, load each colony once with this mod enabled and save to migrate old saves.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.ConfirmPrepareForModRemova: Clear all custom work groups and remove Work Tab Groups data from this save? You must save the game afterward before disabling the mod.
LanguageData.WorkTabGroups.PreparedForModRemoval: Work Tab Groups data removed from this colony. Save the game now, then you can disable the mod.
